title: The canonical coefficient pushout comparison is invertible
statement:
For the actual four coefficient sheaves and specified scalar maps [def-pur-twist-coefficient-rings], the canonical morphism purTwistCoefficientComparison from their pushout to the completed coefficient sheaf is an isomorphism. No hypothesis on invertibility of l on the scheme is needed.

theorem purTwistCoefficientComparison_isIso (S : Scheme.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] :
    IsIso (purTwistCoefficientComparison S l E)

source.place: Coefficient-twist blueprint proof step 6; Stacks Tag 03EK.

proof.text: The normalized tensor map is bijective by purTwistCoefficientTensor. Transport CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct along this ring equivalence on each object. Its pure-tensor formula identifies the two given legs. Apply the sectionwise sheaf pushout lemma. The resulting pushout isomorphism is inverse to the canonical comparison, by hom_ext and the comparison leg equations.
